{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Number of unique patient_ids: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total number of rows: {len(data)}')

# Check how many duplicates there are
duplicate_counts = data["patient_id"].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = duplicate_counts[duplicate_counts > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_patients.index.tolist()}')

# Confirm the sample_seq is higher for re-tests
print(f'Check: highest sample_seq per patient?')
print(data.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().head())"}
